lourdes.summary: Ziegler closed a $32.5M tax-exempt direct placement refinancing for Lourdes Senior Community, a not-for-profit CCRC operated by Dominican Health Care Corporation, to refinance existing 2019 bonds and finance construction of a new 60-unit independent living building.
lourdes.source_title: ZIEGLER CLOSES $32,453,000 FINANCING FOR LOURDES SENIOR COMMUNITY

cibc_53m.summary: CIBC closed a $53M cash-out refinancing for a 9-facility, 930-bed skilled nursing portfolio in Pennsylvania owned by a regional operator.
cibc_53m.source_title: Skilled Nursing Dealbook: 13 Facilities in Pennsylvania Get $80M in Financing; 5-Facility Portfolio Changes Hands in Ohio

blueprint_dayton.summary: Blueprint advised on the sale of a 40-unit assisted living and 75-bed skilled nursing campus near Dayton, Ohio, to a regional Ohio owner/operator with an established presence in the state.
blueprint_dayton.source_title: Skilled Nursing Dealbook: $170.5M in Financing Closed For 7 Skilled Nursing Facilities and Portfolios

_before_site.headline: Regional Owner/Operator acquired a facility in OH

blueprint_reit.summary: Blueprint completed the sale of 3 Ohio SNF and long-term care facilities (nearly 250 beds) on behalf of a public REIT to an Ohio-based provider seeking to expand its footprint, closing June 30, 2026.
blueprint_reit.source_title: Skilled Nursing Dealbook: $170.5M in Financing Closed For 7 Skilled Nursing Facilities and Portfolios

strawberry_marshall.summary: Strawberry Fields REIT acquired a hospital campus in Marshall, Missouri, comprising a 60-bed hospital, 99-bed skilled nursing facility, and medical office building. The campus was added to an existing Master Lease with an affiliate of American Medical Administrators (formerly Reliant Care Group), bringing the Company's total healthcare facilities in Missouri to 21.
strawberry_marshall.source_title: Strawberry Fields REIT Acquires Marshall, Missouri Hospital Campus, Expands Missouri Portfolio | STRW Stock News
